To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
diagnostic studies can help to improve the contribution of agricultural science to the livelihoods of farmers.
diagnostic studies are a useful tool for agricultural research to increase its contribution to resource-poor farmers.
diagnostic studies can contribute to making agricultural research more responsive to the needs of resource-poor farmers and that this can be achieved in two ways.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question of whether diagnostic studies are an effective way of improving the contribution of research to farmers' needs and livelihoods.
the question of how to make agricultural research more responsive to the needs and opportunities in the livelihood strategies of resource-poor farmers in Africa.
how the diagnostic studies contributed to a more effective research process and a more appropriate research output.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
diagnostic studies are an effective tool for improving the contribution that agricultural research makes to farmers' livelihood improvement.
diagnostic studies have contributed to making the Convergence of Science project more relevant to farmers and to the local environment.
diagnostic studies have contributed to the success of the project by improving the relevance of its research.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
diagnostic studies have been a useful tool for increasing the likelihood that the research will be relevant for the resource-poor farmers with whom it is being conducted.
diagnostic studies are an important tool for agricultural researchers to improve their contribution to resource-poor farmers in developing countries.
diagnostic studies can contribute to improving the contribution of research to farmers' needs and priorities.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the inclusion of diagnostic studies in the research process of agricultural researchers is an excellent way to increase the likelihood of the research resulting in the development and testing of technologies that are relevant for resource-poor farmers and that are acceptable to the farmers.
the diagnostic studies were a key step in the process of developing technologies together with farmers, and that diagnostic studies are therefore a valuable addition to agricultural research.
diagnostic studies are an effective way for agricultural research to be grounded in farmers' needs.
